title: TA-14 Environmental Integrity Ecosystem Architecture Specification

relatedProfiles.gateB: Reserved: separate frozen specification (B1); not implemented
relatedProfiles.calculationReferenceRegistry: CRR-1: contract frozen here; entries activate separately

fingerprintRule: SHA-256 over canonical JSON (keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace) of this document.
invariants: Gate A ALLOW never implies Gate B ALLOW; gate_b_authorized is never set by Gate A.

No universal HVACD/R or refrigerant quantities, timings, convergence thresholds, electrical limits, performance-degradation definitions or charge rules (generic delta-T, CFM/ton, superheat, subcooling, approach, pressures, line temperatures, psychrometric performance) are defined by this architecture.
A declaration never verifies itself: DECLARED -> DOCUMENTED -> VERIFIED/ESTABLISHED.
Unknown, missing, stale, simulated-in-production, unsealed, unactivated or out-of-scope conditions fail closed.
canonicalChain: NIRET / Gate A (only when pressure-side entry is proposed)

stages.RECORD: sealed, sequenced window entry; Recorder; no consequence
stages.CALCULATION: derived value with lineage under an activated CRR-1 reference; Analyzer; no consequence
stages.INTERPRETATION: thermodynamic behavior finding; Analyzer; no consequence
stages.TECHNICAL_DETERMINATION: criterion-bound result and Declared Diagnostic Determination; Analyzer computes, qualified technician accepts; no consequence
stages.AUTHORITY: Gate A or Gate B receipt; gate engines only; enables, never performs
stages.COMMIT: bounded Gate B commitment; enables execution only
stages.EXECUTION: physical refrigerant transfer; Governor; only within the commitment
stages.OUTCOME: HPR-V and comparison; Node -> Recorder -> Analyzer; no consequence

may: produce raw observations under the observation contract
create, sequence, seal and close evidence windows on defined triggers
mayNot: allow any submitter to alter preserved entries

may: calculate only through activated CRR-1 references
compute technical determinations against governed criteria
mayNot: turn a calculation reference or thermodynamic behavior into equipment-specific OEM authority

may: sole authority for a bounded refrigerant-mass intervention (future B1)
mayNot: be satisfied by Gate A ALLOW alone

may: execute only within a valid Gate B commitment
governor.profiles: Execution strategies (e.g. psychrometric-observed, OEM-method) are bounded profiles of one Governor and carry no authority; any TA-14 governed execution profile must be separately versioned and frozen.

may: accept or disagree with a computed determination (separately recorded)
mayNot: edit preserved records or Analyzer results

may: grant or withdraw a consent object
mayNot: create technical admissibility or execution authority

holds: S12H no step on failed revalidation
rules: Transitions are forward-only and each requires the predecessor receipt or seal.
S6 opens only on a C1-R7 receipt with determination=ALLOW (technical and execution) and scope=PRESSURE_EVIDENCE_ONLY.
Gate A DENY/HOLD/ESCALATE or a determination indicating no intervention proceeds to closure without intervention, or back to a curable state.

A material change (identity, configuration, hazard, continuity gap, unrecorded intervention, consent withdrawal, credential or standing loss, reference deactivation) returns the lifecycle to the earliest state whose evidence it undermines; prior receipts are preserved with standing CHALLENGED.
entryHash = SHA-256(prevEntryHash || canonical(entry)).
Node, Analyzer, Governor and technician append attributable events only; no update or delete; corrections are new entries referencing the corrected entry.
The actor is not the sole historian: Governor events require corroborating Node observations in the same EXECUTION window; uncorroborated execution is DEGRADED and cannot close as verified.

fields: location{physical,class A|B|C,basis(OEM citation or governed method id)}
rules: Raw values only; no derived values, stability, drift or diagnostic judgement.
Pressure channels are admissible only inside a PRESSURE_EVIDENCE window; pressure observed elsewhere is recorded as premature entry (C1-R7 A1).
Missing required field, undeclared unit or unparseable time is rejected, never repaired.
No sensor manufacturer or device is architectural authority; adapters map sources onto this contract.

activationPrerequisites: lawful possession and permitted use of the reference and any implementation ESTABLISHED by evidence
implementation conformance-tested against the pinned reference

candidateEntries.identity: ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals (2025), Chapter 1 Psychrometrics, SI and I-P
NIST Standard Reference Database 23, REFPROP Version 10.0, full mixture model at the composition of the ASHRAE Standard 34 designation

s05_calculation.implementationRule: An implementation (e.g. PsychroLib, which states it implements the 2017 ASHRAE Fundamentals Chapter 1) is admissible only for the reference it is conformance-verified against; it never substitutes for a different edition and is never itself a governing reference.
catalogue: air mass flow from governed airflow evidence
sensible, latent and total heat rate
rules: Pure, deterministic functions declaring referenceId, calculationVersion, input observation ids and hashes, output units and uncertainty propagation.
No threshold comparisons inside calculations.
Missing, ambiguous, incompatible, unactivated or out-of-domain reference, or missing input: CALCULATION NOT ESTABLISHED; dependent determinations fail closed.
A calculation reference never becomes equipment-specific or OEM authority.

s06_determinationBoundary.interpretation: Behavior findings describe thermodynamic behavior; never charge rules; never authority.
s06_determinationBoundary.determination: Declared propositions evaluated only against governed criteria: OEM-bound where authoritative OEM criteria exist (A7/A8 registry); otherwise equipment-specific propositions are INDETERMINATE or NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_OEM_CRITERION.
s06_determinationBoundary.oemPrecedence: Where an applicable governed OEM charging procedure supplies or explicitly requires its own pressure-temperature relationship, table, chart, correction or calculation method, that OEM method governs the equipment-specific determination within its stated applicability. A CRR-1 reference may be used for independent calculation or comparison but never silently replaces the OEM method; differences are recorded as findings. If the OEM procedure requires a saturation value but its convention is not stated in the governed record and no activated CRR-1 convention applies, the input is NOT ESTABLISHED. If the OEM procedure is internally conflicting, the determination is HOLD.

s07_hpr.HPR0: As-found record sealed before any disturbance; never superseded.
s07_hpr.HPR_BL: Stabilized baseline immediately before the governed intervention: Part A non-invasive; Part B pressure evidence only under Gate A ALLOW. Any non-refrigerant correction after HPR0 is recorded as an intervention with its own post-state and a new HPR-BL is sealed.
s07_hpr.HPR_V: Post-intervention record with the same channels, locations, location basis and governed methods as HPR-BL, instruments of equivalent fitness, linked to HPR-BL; only matched channels are compared; unmatched is NOT_COMPARABLE.

classes: OUTSIDE_OEM_CRITERION (direction only as the OEM states it)
rules: The computed part is immutable; acceptance cannot alter it.
DISAGREED creates a separately attributable disagreement/correction record.
Acceptance requires independently established identity and qualification (G3); otherwise HOLD.
DISAGREED or INDETERMINATE cannot support Gate B (HOLD).
Standing CURRENT; CHALLENGED on material change or profile-declared validity expiry.

s09_gateAInterface: An adapter builds the C1-R7 input from sealed windows, packaging Node readings as Measurements with instrument, location class and governed method; the engine recomputes all derivations.
The C1-R7 receipt is preserved into the Recorder.
Continuous series are not consumed by C1-R7; continuous-evidence Gate A semantics require a separately frozen amendment (e.g. C1-R8).

s10_gateB.form: Separate frozen specification (B1) under the TA-14 Gate; not implemented.

purposes.undefined: DENY or ESCALATE; no generic Gate A bypass

propositions.B-P02: Gate A ALLOW receipt and sealed HPR-BL exist
propositions.B-P03: Declared Diagnostic Determination ACCEPTED, CURRENT, OEM-bound, directional
propositions.B-P04: Execution authority: independently verified certification (NIRET verifier architecture), authenticated submitter, not self-issued
propositions.B-P05: Consent current, covering scope, with consent-giver standing ESTABLISHED
propositions.B-P06: Custody source or destination identified and measurable
propositions.B-P07: Bound completeness and provenance (each bound OEM_CRITERION or TECHNICIAN_DECLARED)
propositions.B-P08: Bound admissibility: technician-declared bounds require a declarant with ESTABLISHED qualification
propositions.B-P09: EXECUTION window openable and baseline sealed
propositions.B-P10: No material change since the determination (GCEA standing)
propositions.B-P11: No safety exclusion (e.g. A2L, unresolved hazard)
propositions.B-P12: Bound consistency: no contradiction of a governed OEM record or of the determination direction; step bound resolvable within the custody instrument's declared accuracy
propositions.B-P13: Stop-condition observability: every declared stop condition references an observable channel or Analyzer output

bounds: stop conditions including any 'performance worsens' definition and electrical limits
boundRules: OEM requirements control where applicable authoritative OEM criteria exist.
Technician-declared bounds are attributable inputs, not OEM criteria and not technical truth; Gate B evaluates their admissibility before commitment.
Missing or unknown required bounds: HOLD.
receipt: scope and committed bounds with provenance
s10_gateB.invariant: Gate A ALLOW is evidence for B-P02 only and never satisfies any B-P alone; a missing proposition is HOLD, never ALLOW.

rules: Consent is a separate, attributable, revocable authority object; necessary where applicable, never independently sufficient.

Consent-giver standing must be independently established; no owner/occupant/agent verification source is invented; until one exists consent standing and execution authority are HOLD / NOT ESTABLISHED.
Checked before every Governor step; withdrawal during execution causes controlled stop/HOLD and termination CONSENT_WITHDRAWN.
Transferred mass must reconcile with Governor step totals within declared uncertainty; mismatch is a custody discrepancy: stop/HOLD.
The Governor cannot create, estimate or backfill custody evidence.
Any command parameter not in the commitment is rejected (GOV-CMD-BOUND_NOT_COMMITTED).
No receipt contains an authority field.

s14_preExecutionRevalidation.when: Immediately before the first step and before every step (GCEA evaluateExecutionAttempt pattern).
checks: consent valid and consent-giver standing ESTABLISHED
custody container identified and scale fit
CRR-1 references still ACTIVE and pinned
s14_preExecutionRevalidation.onFailure: HOLD; no step; nothing carried forward from a prior check.

steps: termination opens POST_STABILIZATION window (duration from the OEM criterion or the committed bound; neither: HOLD)
closure receipt; sealed record becomes the next governed baseline
s15_outcomeClosure.rule: An outcome claim never exceeds what was re-measured.

s16_failClosed: Unknown, missing, stale, simulated in production, unsealed or out-of-scope: HOLD (ESCALATE when outside scope).
Pressure observation outside a PRESSURE_EVIDENCE window: premature entry, DENY (C1-R7 A1).
No Gate B evaluation without a Gate A receipt and sealed HPR-BL, except under a separately defined purpose.
No Governor step without a commitment and per-step revalidation.
Disagreement or indeterminacy blocks Gate B.
Undefined Gate B purpose: DENY or ESCALATE.
Unactivated, unpossessed, unconfirmed or out-of-domain calculation reference: NOT ESTABLISHED.
Bound without provenance, or missing required bound: HOLD.
HOLD is never read as ALLOW; absence of DENY is never permission.
s18_provenance: SHA-256 over canonical JSON for every object; hash-chained window entries; Recorder seals signed with a server-side key.
Every derived value records input observation hashes, function id, referenceId, implementation hash and calculationVersion.
Every determination, receipt and outcome references predecessor seal hashes.
Recorder clock is authoritative; source time is preserved.
Replay from sealed windows must reproduce the determination hash.

appendOnlyStores: CRR-1 registry entries and activation events
rules: Gate A receipts are referenced, not duplicated.
Recorder seals under the service role; submitters append only their own attributable events; row-level security; no update or delete grants.
s19_persistence.ownerPolicy: Retention and volume for continuous raw time series (not an architecture blocker).

s20_simulation: Simulated Node sources, scale and actuator are deterministic fixtures with acquisitionMethod=SIMULATED.
Simulated observations never support a production determination or gate input.
The simulated actuator performs no physical action.
Architecture precedes hardware; begin with simulated or read-only adapters.
s21_conformance: Per-contract conformance suites for s03 to s15.

Invariant tests: no history rewrite; hash chain; Gate A never implies Gate B; no step without revalidation; consent withdrawal mid-step; custody mismatch; SIMULATED rejected in production; no generic charge rules (static checks extended to Analyzer and Governor code); bound absent from commitment rejected.
Reference tests: implementation conformance against the pinned reference before activation; out-of-domain input yields NOT ESTABLISHED; unactivated reference yields NOT ESTABLISHED.
Adversarial tests: forged events, self-issued authority, reordered windows, backdated seals, uncorroborated Governor events.
Golden replay tests of sealed chains.

executionAuthorityAndStanding: CertificationVerifier and AuthorityEstablisher interfaces in apps/web/lib/niret/server-evaluate.ts
appendOnlyPersistence: GCEA lifecycle verifications, AFA/EABA append-only evidence and certification-verification migrations

EIR describing NIRET as verified justification for intervention.
Ecosystem page: Analyzer 'does not diagnose' (superseded by ruling 1); 'five tools, three roles'; two separate Governors.
Repository Step 13: 'Evaluate and, when justified, adjust refrigerant' in one step.
Academy blueprint sequence without Gate B.
Public positioning of 'Analyzer-driven' and 'autonomous' charging (patent filings out of scope).
TA-14 Gate examples/hvac_execution_demo.json: ALLOW for refrigerant adjustment after threshold_check_completed (Gate repository; not modified).
s24_operationalActivationDependencies: CRR-1 entries remain CANDIDATE until lawful possession and permitted use are established, independently reviewed, conformance-tested, hash-pinned and activated; until then all dependent calculations are NOT ESTABLISHED.
No consent-giver standing source exists; consent standing and execution authority are HOLD until one is established.
No reachable governed OEM package; equipment-specific determinations resolve to NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_OEM_CRITERION or NO_RECORD.
Gate B (B1) specification to be separately frozen before any Governor execution.
